name: Durham YouthWorks
org: City of Durham, Office of Economic and Workforce Development
what_you_do: Get paid to learn job skills in the spring. Then work in summer, online or in person, with a city office, a nonprofit, or a local business.
who_can_apply: Teens and young adults ages 14 to 21 who live in Durham or Durham County. You need an email address that you check often.
pay_detail: Earn up to $880 and beyond if you finish both Part 1 (training) and Part 2 (summer work).
duration: Part 1 training in the spring, then Part 2 summer work experience.
deadline_text: The page says applications open at the start of the year. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online when applications open early in the year. Spots may be chosen by lottery.
notes: In 2026, more than 500 youth finished Part 1 and 120 were placed in hybrid or in-person jobs, so not everyone gets an in-person job. Questions: youthworks@durhamnc.gov. The city has a Getting Prepared Guide on the page.
